content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197 (no prior auth at time of service) and the payer's retro-auth window closed at 30 days post-service (now 143 days), with no peer-to-peer offered. Documentation quality is 0.32, so a medical-necessity appeal has little chance and would only add touches; correcting codes was already tried and cannot cure a missing authorization. Since the auth failure is the provider's administrative error, the balance cannot be shifted to the patient beyond their contractual share, so the account should be closed.","action":"write_off"}
